# hivelocity_device_port (Resource)

Manages the network configuration of a single device port (or bond): whether it is enabled, its native VLAN and the IP assignments routed to it. Only attributes set in the configuration are changed; unset attributes keep their current value. Removing the resource from Terraform leaves the port configured as-is (it does not clear the port, which could disconnect the device).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_device_port" "public" {
  device_id = 12345
  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["eth0"]
  }
}

data "hivelocity_ip_assignment" "extra" {
  ip_address = "66.165.231.130"
}

# Route an additional IP assignment to the device's public port.
resource "hivelocity_device_port" "public" {
  device_id         = 12345
  port_id           = data.hivelocity_device_port.public.port_id
  ip_assignment_ids = [data.hivelocity_ip_assignment.extra.assignment_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the device the port belongs to.
- `port_id` (Number) ID of the port (see the `hivelocity_device_port` data source).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the port is enabled.
- `ip_assignment_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the IP assignments routed to this port.
- `native_vlan_id` (Number) ID of the VLAN used as the port's native (untagged) VLAN. Set to `0` to remove it.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the port.
- `name` (String) Interface name, for example `eth1` or `bond0`.
- `native_vlan_tag` (Number) VLAN tag of the native VLAN, if any.
- `private` (Boolean) True for private (back-end) ports.
- `status` (String) Port status as reported by the API.
- `type` (String) Port type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with <device_id>:<port_id>
terraform import hivelocity_device_port.public 12345:67890
```
